records.scope: The reference build. Proofs concern the analyzed AIR of this mode as recorded in the schema-12 profile. Native behaviour of this build is related to the model only by bounded differential tests and ABI probes; no backend preservation theorem. The native differential runs (aarch64-macos, x86_64-linux) of every example also compare this build with the model: no mismatch.
records.premise: The theorem's Lean model is the ReleaseSafe analyzed AIR named in the generated profile header (PRF-02), with safety-checked illegal behaviour as Zig.Error (SEM-01). The exporter/translator fidelity (TRU-02) and LLVM lowering of the same source with -OReleaseSafe -mcpu=baseline (TRU-03) are trusted, supported only by golden comparisons and bounded native differential tests.
commands: python3 scripts/build-guard.py --timeout 10800 -- env AIR2LEAN_ZIG=/abs/stock/zig-0.16.0 AIR2LEAN_DIFF_OPTIMIZE=ReleaseSafe AIR2LEAN_DIFF_BACKEND=llvm AIR2LEAN_DIFF_REPORT=tests/diff/out/report-ReleaseSafe.json bash scripts/diff.sh

records.scope: Only the claim in README.md: a proof that a function never throws on given inputs implies its ReleaseFast build has no illegal behaviour on those inputs and returns the modelled value. No output, layout or performance correspondence is claimed beyond the tested inputs, and no ReleaseFast AIR is translated. Exception: float @divExact with a non-integral quotient (see premise).
records.premise: ReleaseFast compiles the same source as the ReleaseSafe reference build and only removes safety checks, so it may diverge from the ReleaseSafe model only on executions with illegal behaviour. If the model does not throw on an input, the source has no illegal behaviour on that input, provided Sema/export/translation (TRU-02) and LLVM lowering (TRU-03) are faithful. The differential runs support this on every input on which the model does not throw, except float @divExact with a non-integral quotient: that is illegal behaviour that ReleaseSafe does not detect, so the model does not throw and the ReleaseFast result differs (triaged with a reproducer). The premise also excludes code under @setRuntimeSafety(false), @setFloatMode(.optimized), different CPU features or error tracing, and any differing comptime branch on @import("builtin").mode.
commands: python3 scripts/build-guard.py --timeout 10800 -- env AIR2LEAN_ZIG=/abs/stock/zig-0.16.0 AIR2LEAN_DIFF_OPTIMIZE=ReleaseFast AIR2LEAN_DIFF_BACKEND=llvm AIR2LEAN_DIFF_REPORT=tests/diff/out/report-ReleaseFast.json bash scripts/diff.sh
